name: CostumeQuestVita
description: PS Vita port of Costume Quest, based on the 2015 Android/OUYA PowerVR build.
long_description: PS Vita port of Costume Quest, based on the 2015 Android/OUYA PowerVR build. It loads the original ARM libraries from the APK using so_util, FalsoJNI and vitaGL, starting from the soloader-boilerplate.
